Happy (late) 22nd Birthday, Chiu.

est. 9 Aug 2004
A note that's a few days late

Better late than never, right?

I'll be honest — I missed it. Your birthday came and went, and somewhere between everything else going on, I let the day slip by without saying a word. I'm sorry for that, Chiu. Twelve-ish years of knowing each other and I still managed to forget the date.

We were ten years old in the same school when this whole friendship started, and somehow it's followed me through every version of myself since. Not many people stick around that long, and even fewer get a nickname out of it that's outlasted everything else.

So instead of a late "happy birthday" text, you're getting this: a whole little website, built with the photos I had saved of you, and everything I actually wanted to say. Here's to 22 — I hope this year treats you gently, stretches you in the good ways, and hands you a few of those quiet, ordinary-day kind of joys that end up mattering the most.

— with love, always a little late but never in spirit, Ayush

For your 22nd year

What I hope this year brings you

i.

Days that feel unhurried — the kind where nothing urgent is calling for your attention and you can just exist for a while.

ii.

People around you who notice the small things, and who show up even when it isn't convenient — the way you always do for others.

iii.

A little more softness toward yourself, especially on the days you feel like you're falling short of your own expectations.

iv.

At least one adventure you didn't plan for — a trip, a decision, a yes that surprises even you.

v.

Good health, real rest, and the confidence to ask for both when you need them.

vi.

And from me — a promise to remember the date properly next year. Twelve years in, you'd think I'd have it memorized by now. Consider this a standing apology and an early save-the-date.

Happy birthday, Chiu. Late by a few days, but every word here has been true the whole time. Here's to 22, and to whatever ten-year-old version of you would think of us now. 🎉
